name: North Carolina

response.rule_text: No specific time limit; records must be furnished 'as promptly as possible' (G.S. § 132-6); courts have not interpreted the standard.

fees.labor_rule: Special service charge allowed for extensive IT resources or extensive clerical/supervisory assistance (§ 132-6.2(b)); agency bears cost of separating confidential material (§ 132-6(c)).
fees.copy_rule: Agency may charge only actual cost of making a copy (§ 132-6.2(b)).
fees.waiver_rule: No fee-waiver provisions; no statutory requirement to collect a fee.

residency.rule_text: Any person may request; purpose is irrelevant and may not be asked (§ 132-6).

appeal.rule_text: No administrative appeal; enforcement by civil suit, no specific statute of limitations (G.S. 1-52(2) three years may be argued). Fee disputes may go to State CIO mediation (§ 132-6.2(b)); court mediation starts within 30 days of responsive pleadings (G.S. 7A-38.3E(b)). Prevailing requester gets fees (§ 132-9(c)).

format_rule: Copies in any medium the agency can provide; request may not be denied because agency prefers another medium (§ 132-6.2(a)); no duty to create records (§ 132-6.2(e)).
notes: Read chars 0-100k and 150-250k. Legislature: 2023 amendment to G.S. 120-135 shields legislators' documents and requests (RCFP), so false is partial. Delay as denial: no appellate court so held (2021 trial ruling did). School districts only via unpublished trial ruling. RCFP updated Oct 1 2025.
